LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_LifeBurn.label: <color=#FF7A45>Life Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_LifeBurn.description: Hostile burn inflicted by Mingyuan's attacks. Design target: drains age and needs, slows movement and accuracy, reduces damage and work speed, damages gear durability, increases incoming damage, deals scaling true damage every 2 seconds, and transfers half its layers to nearby enemies on death.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_SelfBurn.label: <color=#FFB25C>Self Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_SelfBurn.description: A beneficial burn counter Mingyuan applies to herself. Design target: increases damage, movement, attack speed, work speed, shield regeneration, and Life Burn stacking power, then naturally decays.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningBody.label: <color=#FFD37A>Burning Body</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningBody.description: Mingyuan's otherworld-forged body. Design target: massive part health, consciousness boost, heat and blast conversion into healing or shield, counterburn on hit, periodic restoration, need locking, and short invulnerability when body parts lose health.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_ProtectiveFlameShield.label: <color=#FFE0A3>Protective Flame Shield</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_ProtectiveFlameShield.descri: Mingyuan's flame shield. Design target: 200 energy, ignores very small and very large hits, regenerates, rebuilds after breaking, clears hostile control states on hit, and prevents death while active.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_RebirthFlame.label: <color=#FF5C3A>Rebirth Flame</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_RebirthFlame.description: Mingyuan's death interception logic. Design target: explode on death, enter Eternal Burning for 30 seconds, become unselectable and unable to attack, then return in optimal condition.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_EternalBurning.label: <color=#FF2E1F>Eternal Burning</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_EternalBurning.description: The 30-second rebirth marker state created by Rebirth Flame.
